title: Interstellar
description: A former pilot leaves his children behind to travel through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity, while time slips away differently for him than for the family waiting on a dying Earth.

title: The Matrix
description: An office worker who hacks at night discovers that everyday reality is a computer simulation built by machines, and joins a band of rebels who can bend its rules.

title: Arrival
description: A linguist is asked to communicate with mysterious visitors whose ships hover over Earth, and learning their language changes how she experiences her own memories.

title: Blade Runner 2049
description: In a rain-soaked future city, an artificial officer who hunts rogue androids uncovers a secret that could upend the line between humans and the beings they built.

title: The Martian
description: An astronaut stranded alone on Mars after his crew believes him dead uses science, potatoes and a sense of humour to stay alive until rescue.

title: Inception
description: A thief who steals secrets from inside people's dreams takes one last job: planting an idea in a target's mind, layers of dreams deep.

title: Ex Machina
description: A young programmer is invited to a remote estate to test whether a humanoid robot built by his reclusive boss is truly conscious, and soon cannot tell who is testing whom.

title: Gravity
description: After debris destroys their shuttle, an engineer drifts in orbit and must find a way back to Earth with oxygen running out.

title: La La Land
description: A jazz pianist and an aspiring actress fall in love in Los Angeles while chasing ambitions that may pull them apart, told through song and dance.

title: The Notebook
description: An elderly man reads a love story from a worn notebook to a woman in a care home: the tale of a summer romance between a poor young man and a wealthy girl.

title: Before Sunrise
description: Two strangers meet on a train across Europe and spend a single night walking around Vienna, talking about life and love before they must part at dawn.

title: Pride & Prejudice
description: In Georgian England, a sharp-tongued young woman clashes with a proud, wealthy gentleman, and both must overcome their first impressions.

title: About Time
description: A young man learns the men in his family can travel back in time, and uses the gift to find love, then discovers what truly matters is ordinary days with family.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
description: A New York economics professor travels to Singapore with her boyfriend and discovers his family is extraordinarily wealthy, and his mother does not approve of her.

title: Get Out
description: A young Black man visits his white girlfriend's family for a weekend, and their overly welcoming behaviour hides something sinister.

title: A Quiet Place
description: A family survives on a farm in total silence, because the creatures that have wiped out most of humanity hunt by sound.

title: Hereditary
description: After the death of a secretive grandmother, a family's grief curdles into terrifying discoveries about their ancestry.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family terrorised by a dark presence in their isolated farmhouse in 1970s Rhode Island.

title: It
description: A group of misfit kids in a small town band together to fight a shape-shifting monster that most often appears as a clown and feeds on fear.

title: The Shining
description: A struggling writer takes a winter job caring for an empty mountain hotel with his wife and son, and the isolation and the hotel itself slowly drive him to madness.

title: Spirited Away
description: A sullen ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits, where she must work in a bathhouse for gods to free her parents, who have been turned into pigs.

title: Toy Story
description: A pull-string cowboy doll feels threatened when a shiny new space ranger becomes his boy's favourite toy, and the two rivals end up lost together.

title: Up
description: A grumpy widower ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly to South America, not realising an eager young scout is stuck on his porch.

title: Inside Out
description: Inside the mind of an eleven-year-old girl who has just moved cities, her personified emotions Joy and Sadness get lost and must find their way back.

title: Coco
description: A boy who dreams of becoming a musician despite his family's ban on music crosses into the Land of the Dead on the Day of the Dead and uncovers his family history.

title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
description: A Brooklyn teenager gains spider powers and teams up with spider-heroes from other dimensions, in a film that looks like a comic book come alive.

title: Finding Nemo
description: An overprotective clownfish crosses the ocean with a forgetful blue tang to rescue his son, who was captured and placed in a dentist's fish tank.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
description: Two young sisters move to the countryside to be near their sick mother and befriend gentle forest spirits, including a huge furry creature.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A fussy concierge at a famous European hotel and his loyal lobby boy are caught up in the theft of a priceless painting and a fight over a family fortune.

title: Superbad
description: Two awkward high-school best friends try to buy alcohol for a party in a last-ditch attempt to impress girls before they leave for different colleges.

title: The Hangover
description: Three friends wake up in a trashed Las Vegas hotel suite after a bachelor party with no memory of the night, and the groom is missing.

title: Groundhog Day
description: A cynical TV weatherman covering a small-town festival is forced to relive the same day over and over until he becomes a better person.

title: Paddington 2
description: A polite young bear from Peru takes odd jobs to buy a special gift for his aunt, but is wrongly sent to prison when the gift is stolen.

title: Knives Out
description: When a wealthy crime novelist is found dead after his birthday party, an eccentric detective investigates his scheming family.

title: Parasite
description: A poor family schemes its way into working for a rich household one by one, until an unexpected discovery turns their plan upside down.

title: Se7en
description: Two detectives, one weeks from retirement, hunt a serial killer who stages each murder around one of the seven deadly sins.

title: Gone Girl
description: When a woman disappears on her fifth wedding anniversary, media attention and police suspicion fall on her husband, but nothing is what it seems.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned cannibal psychiatrist to catch another serial killer who is still at large.

title: Prisoners
description: When two young girls go missing on Thanksgiving, a desperate father takes matters into his own hands while a detective follows the official investigation.

title: The Dark Knight
description: A masked vigilante faces an anarchic criminal mastermind who wants to plunge a city into chaos and test how far its heroes will go.

title: Pulp Fiction
description: Interlocking stories of hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and small-time robbers in Los Angeles, told out of order with sharp dialogue.

title: The Godfather
description: The ageing head of a New York crime family hands control to his reluctant youngest son, who is gradually drawn into the family business.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker sentenced to life in prison for a murder he did not commit forms a lasting friendship with a fellow inmate and holds on to hope over decades.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind man with a simple outlook stumbles through decades of American history while never giving up on his childhood sweetheart.

title: Whiplash
description: A young jazz drummer at an elite music school is pushed to his limits by a ruthless, abusive instructor.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman and his young son face homelessness while he competes for an unpaid internship at a stockbroking firm.

title: Good Will Hunting
description: A janitor at a top university is secretly a maths genius, and a therapist helps him confront his past and decide what to do with his life.

title: 3 Idiots
description: Two friends search for their long-lost college companion, recalling how he challenged a rigid engineering college that valued marks over learning.

title: Dangal
description: A former wrestler trains his daughters to become world-class wrestlers, defying village traditions about what girls should do.
Two school sweethearts who drifted apart meet again at a class reunion twenty-two years later and spend one night revisiting what might have been.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: In a desert wasteland, a rebel warrior and a drifter flee a tyrant across the sand in a war rig, chased by an army of vehicles.

title: John Wick
description: A retired hitman returns to the criminal underworld for revenge after gangsters kill the puppy left to him by his late wife.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
description: A veteran navy test pilot returns to train a group of young graduates for a dangerous mission, including the son of his late best friend.

title: Gladiator
description: A Roman general betrayed by the emperor's son is sold into slavery and fights his way through the arena to seek revenge.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
description: An archaeologist and adventurer races against the Nazis to find a powerful ancient artefact, dodging traps, snakes and rolling boulders.

title: Baahubali: The Beginning
description: A young man raised in a village below a giant waterfall climbs it and discovers his royal heritage in a kingdom ruled by a tyrant.

title: RRR
description: In 1920s colonial India, two revolutionaries on opposite sides form a powerful friendship while fighting British rule.

title: Vikram
description: A special agent investigates a series of masked murders and uncovers a sprawling drug network and a team of hidden operatives.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit inherits a powerful ring and sets out with a fellowship of companions to destroy it before a dark lord can reclaim it.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: An orphaned boy learns on his eleventh birthday that he is a wizard and begins his first year at a school of witchcraft and wizardry.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
description: In post-civil-war Spain, a girl escapes her cruel stepfather's world into a mysterious labyrinth where a faun gives her dangerous tasks.

title: Free Solo
description: A rock climber attempts to scale a 3,000-foot granite wall in Yosemite with no ropes or safety gear.

title: My Octopus Teacher
description: A filmmaker going through a hard time spends a year diving in a South African kelp forest and forms an unusual bond with an octopus.

title: Jiro Dreams of Sushi
description: An elderly sushi master who runs a tiny Tokyo restaurant devotes his life to perfecting his craft while his son waits to succeed him.
